question: What must we always do before crossing a busy road? 🚦
explanation: Super! To be smart and safe, we must always look left and right before crossing any road! 👀
hint: You need to check for cars.

question: Where is the safest place for us to walk on the road? 🚶
explanation: Great job! Walking on the footpath keeps us safely away from moving cars and buses! 🚶
hint: It is a path made just for walking.

question: Which color of the traffic light tells cars to stop? 🛑
explanation: Awesome! The bright red light tells all the vehicles to stop right away! 🔴
hint: It is the color of an apple.

question: Which color of the traffic light tells cars to go? 🚦
explanation: Super! The green light means it is safe for the vehicles to move forward! 🟢
hint: It is the color of grass.

question: What should we use to cross the road safely? 🦓
explanation: Fantastic! The black and white zebra crossing is the safest place for walking across the road! 🦓
hint: It has black and white stripes.

question: If a stranger offers you candy, what should you say? 🍬
explanation: Awesome! We must always say a firm no to gifts from people we do not know! 🛑

question: Who is a safe adult you can always talk to at school? 🏫
explanation: Great job! Your teacher is a safe adult who loves to help and protect you at school! 👩‍🏫

question: What must we wear on our heads while riding a bicycle? 🚲
explanation: Super! A hard safety helmet protects our head if we ever fall down! ⛑️

question: What keeps us safe when we are sitting in a moving car? 🚗
explanation: Fantastic! Wearing a seatbelt keeps our bodies safe and secure while traveling! 💺
hint: It goes across your chest and lap.

question: Who should you ask for help if you get lost in a busy market? 🚓
explanation: Awesome! A police officer wears a uniform and is trained to help children who are lost! 👮

question: What do we call a loving hug from our mother? 🤗
explanation: Super! A hug from parents makes us feel happy and safe, so it is a good touch! 💖

question: If someone's touch makes you feel bad or scared, what should you do? 😟
explanation: Great job! You should shout loudly and run to a safe adult if you ever feel uncomfortable! 🏃

question: What important numbers should you memorize to stay safe? 📱
explanation: Fantastic! Knowing your parents' phone number helps you call them quickly if there is an emergency! ☎️
hint: It helps you call your family.

question: Where is the best and safest place to play games? ⚽
explanation: Awesome! A park has soft grass and safe spaces to run and play with friends! 🏞️

question: What should you do if you find a sharp knife on the floor? 🔪
explanation: Super! An adult will pick it up safely so nobody gets hurt! 🗣️

question: How should you hold your parents' hands in a very crowded place? 👨‍👧
explanation: Great job! Holding hands tightly keeps you close to your family in a crowd! 🤝

question: What should we do before opening the front door for someone? 🚪
explanation: Fantastic! Looking through the peephole helps you check if it is a safe person outside! 👀

question: If a stranger asks you to walk away with them, what do you do? 🚶‍♂️
explanation: Awesome! Always run away fast to a safe adult if a stranger asks you to go with them! 🏃

question: What is the safest tool to use to trim our nails? 💅
explanation: Super! A nail cutter is specially made to trim our nails easily and safely! 💅
hint: It is made just for nails.

question: How should we move when we see a 'Wet Floor' sign? ⚠️
explanation: Great job! Walking carefully on a wet floor stops us from slipping and falling down! 🚶

question: Who gives us the correct and safe medicine when we are sick? 💊
explanation: Fantastic! A doctor knows exactly which medicine will make us feel healthy again safely! 👨‍⚕️

question: What should you do if you see a fire in the house? 🔥
explanation: Awesome! Getting out of the house quickly keeps you safe from the smoke and fire! 🏃

question: How should we safely touch electrical switches? ⚡
explanation: Super! Using dry hands keeps us completely safe from electric shocks! 👐

question: What is the best way to travel inside a school bus? 🚌
explanation: Great job! Sitting quietly helps the driver focus and keeps everyone safe on the ride! 🪑

question: What should you say if someone's behavior makes you feel unsafe? 🛑
explanation: Fantastic! Saying stop loudly shows you are strong and helps others hear you! 🛑

question: Who helps everyone cross a very busy road safely? 🚦
explanation: Awesome! The traffic police guide all the cars and help people cross the road safely! 👮

question: What do we call a happy high-five from a good friend? ✋
explanation: Super! A high-five from a friend is fun and makes us feel great, so it is a good touch! 🌟

question: Where should we keep our money safe while traveling? 💰
explanation: Great job! Keeping money safely inside a zipped bag means we will never lose it! 🎒
hint: Put it in a safe pocket.

question: If you get separated from your parents in a mall, what do you do? 🏢
explanation: Fantastic! The security guard will use their radio to help find your parents quickly! 💂

question: How do we walk safely on the stairs? 🪜
explanation: Awesome! Holding the handrail keeps us balanced so we do not slip on the stairs! 🪜

question: What must we wear to stay safe while riding in a boat? 🚤
explanation: Super! A life jacket helps us float safely in the water! 🦺

question: Who loves you, cares for you, and protects you the most? 👨‍👩‍👧
explanation: Great job! Your parents love you the most and work hard to keep you completely safe! 👨‍👩‍👦

question: What should we do before going to play in a new park? 🌳
explanation: Fantastic! Asking your parents first means they always know you are safe! 🗣️

question: How should we treat stray street dogs to stay safe? 🐕
explanation: Awesome! Giving street animals their space keeps both you and the animals happy and safe! 🚶

question: What should you do if an older kid bullies you? 😢
explanation: Super! Telling your teacher stops the bullying and makes the school safe for everyone! 👩‍🏫

question: What do we call the special body parts covered by a swimsuit? 🩱
explanation: Great job! Private parts belong only to you, and nobody is allowed to touch them! 🛑

question: Who is allowed to check your private parts when you are sick? 🩺
explanation: Fantastic! Only a doctor can check you, and your parents are always there with you! 👨‍⚕️

question: What should we do when the school fire alarm rings loudly? 🔔
explanation: Awesome! Walking calmly in a line helps everyone get outside safely and quickly! 🚶

question: How can we safely use the computer and the internet? 💻
explanation: Super! Parents help us find the best and safest fun games to play online! 👨‍👩‍👦

question: What should you do if a stranger asks where you live? 🏠
explanation: Great job! We must never share our address or personal details with strangers! 🤐

question: What should we do when a car is moving backwards? 🚗
explanation: Fantastic! Standing far back safely lets the driver move without anyone getting hurt! 🛑

question: What should we carry to see clearly when walking in the dark? 🌙
explanation: Awesome! A bright flashlight helps us see the path and keeps us from tripping! 🔦

question: How do we keep our house safe when we go to sleep at night? 🌃
explanation: Super! Locking the doors safely keeps everyone inside secure while sleeping! 🚪

question: What should we do if someone asks us to keep a bad secret? 🤫
explanation: Great job! We should never keep bad secrets. Always tell a safe adult right away! 🗣️

question: What should you do if you fall down while playing and get hurt? 🩹
explanation: Fantastic! Asking for help means an adult can clean the scratch and put a bandage on it! 🗣️

question: How do we cross railway tracks safely? 🚂
explanation: Awesome! Using the overhead bridge keeps us completely safe from the fast trains! 🌉

question: What should we do if we find a lost baby crying in the park? 👶
explanation: Super! A safe adult or guard will help the little baby find its parents quickly! 💂

question: What should we do with our toys after we finish playing? 🧸
explanation: Great job! Putting toys away safely means nobody will trip and fall over them! 📦

question: How do we wait for our turn to go down the slide? 🛝
explanation: Fantastic! Waiting happily in line keeps everyone safe so we can all have fun! 🧍

question: What is the most important rule for swimming safely in a pool? 🏊
explanation: Awesome! An adult can watch you and keep you completely safe while you splash and play! 👨‍👩‍👦
